№1.sovol_en: Nowadays fast food is very popular.
№1.sovol_uz: Hozirgi kunda fast food juda mashhur.
№1.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№1.jovob_en: This essay is about fast food and its advantages and disadvantages. Nowadays fast food is very popular in many countries. One advantage of fast food is that it is quick and convenient. People can buy it easily when they are busy. It is also usually cheaper than some restaurant meals. However, fast food has some disadvantages. It often contains a lot of fat, sugar, and salt, which are not good for our health. Eating too much fast food can cause health problems such as obesity. In my opinion, people should not eat fast food every day. It is better to eat healthy food and have fast food only sometimes. In conclusion, fast food is convenient, but people should eat it in moderation and choose healthy food more often.
№1.jovob_uz: Bu insho fast food va uning foyda hamda zararli tomonlari haqida. Hozirgi kunda fast food ko‘plab mamlakatlarda mashhur. Uning afzalligi tez va qulay ekanligidir. Odamlar band bo‘lganda uni oson sotib olishlari mumkin. Shuningdek, u restoran taomlaridan arzonroq bo‘ladi. Biroq, fast foodning kamchiliklari ham bor. Unda ko‘p yog‘, shakar va tuz bo‘ladi. Juda ko‘p iste'mol qilish sog‘liq muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin. Menimcha, fast foodni har kuni emas, ba'zan iste'mol qilish kerak. Xulosa qilib aytganda, fast food qulay, lekin odamlar uni me’yorida iste’mol qilishi va ko‘proq sog‘lom ovqat tanlashi kerak.

№2.sovol_en: Nowadays social networks such as Facebook, Twitter are very popular.
№2.sovol_uz: Hozirgi kunda Facebook va Twitter kabi ijtimoiy tarmoqlar juda mashhur.
№2.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№2.jovob_en: This essay is about social networks and their advantages and disadvantages. Nowadays social networks such as Facebook and Twitter are very popular. They help people communicate with friends and family from different places. Social networks are also useful for sharing information and learning new things. However, there are some disadvantages. Some people spend too much time online and become less active. There is also false information on social media. In addition, using social networks too much can affect studies and work. I think social networks are useful if people use them carefully and responsibly. It is important to limit screen time and use social media in a positive way. In conclusion, social networks are useful, but people should use them carefully and responsibly.
№2.jovob_uz: Bu insho ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va ularning foyda hamda zararli tomonlari haqida. Hozirgi kunda ijtimoiy tarmoqlar juda mashhur. Ular odamlarning do‘stlari va oila a'zolari bilan muloqot qilishiga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, ma'lumot almashish va yangi narsalarni o‘rganish uchun foydalidir. Biroq, kamchiliklari ham mavjud. Ba'zi odamlar internetda juda ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazadi. Bundan tashqari, noto‘g‘ri ma'lumotlar ham uchraydi. Menimcha, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan mas'uliyat bilan foydalanish kerak. Xulosa qilib aytganda, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar foydali, lekin odamlar ulardan ehtiyotkor va mas’uliyat bilan foydalanishi kerak.

№3.sovol_en: Nowadays online shopping is very popular everywhere.
№3.sovol_uz: Hozirgi kunda onlayn xarid qilish hamma joyda mashhur.
№3.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№3.jovob_en: This essay is about online shopping and its advantages and disadvantages. Nowadays online shopping is very popular all over the world. One advantage is that people can buy products from home without going to a shop. It saves time and offers many choices. Customers can compare prices and find better deals. However, online shopping also has disadvantages. Sometimes products look different from the pictures. Delivery can take a long time, and there may be problems with payments. In my opinion, online shopping is very useful, but people should buy from trusted websites. They should also read reviews before purchasing anything online. In conclusion, online shopping is very convenient, but people should buy from trusted websites.
№3.jovob_uz: Bu insho onlayn xarid qilish va uning foyda hamda zararli tomonlari haqida. Onlayn xarid qilish butun dunyoda mashhur. Odamlar uyidan chiqmasdan mahsulot sotib olishlari mumkin. Bu vaqtni tejaydi va ko‘plab tanlovlarni taklif qiladi. Biroq, ba'zi mahsulotlar rasmdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Yetkazib berish ham uzoq davom etishi mumkin. Menimcha, xaridlarni ishonchli saytlardan qilish va sharhlarni o‘qish kerak. Xulosa qilib aytganda, onlayn xarid qilish juda qulay, lekin odamlar ishonchli saytlardan xarid qilishi kerak.

№4.sovol_en: Write about a memorable travel experience.
№4.sovol_uz: Esda qolarli sayohat tajribangiz haqida yozing.
№4.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№4.sovol_en_4: what you enjoyed most about the trip
№4.jovob_en: This essay is about one of my most memorable travel experiences. One of my most memorable travel experiences was my trip to Samarkand. I travelled there by train with my family. The journey was comfortable and enjoyable. The thing I enjoyed most was visiting historical places and learning about the history of the city. I also liked the traditional food and friendly people. However, we had a small challenge because the weather was very hot during the day. We had to carry water and rest often. Despite this problem, the trip was wonderful. I learned many new things and took a lot of beautiful photos. In conclusion, it was a wonderful trip and I will always remember it.
№4.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening eng esda qolarli sayohat tajribalarimdan biri haqida. Mening eng esda qolarli sayohatim Samarqandga bo‘lgan safarim edi. Men oilam bilan poyezdda bordim. Sayohat juda qulay va yoqimli bo‘ldi. Menga tarixiy joylarni ko‘rish va shahar tarixi haqida bilish juda yoqdi. Milliy taomlar ham mazali edi. Ob-havo juda issiq bo‘lgani uchun biroz qiyinchilik bo‘ldi, ammo sayohat ajoyib o‘tdi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, bu ajoyib sayohat bo‘lgan va men uni doim eslab yuraman.

№5.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№5.sovol_en_3: what activities you do in the morning
№5.sovol_en_4: what you usually do in the afternoon
№5.jovob_en: This essay is about my daily routine. My daily routine is quite simple. In the morning, I wake up at 7 o’clock, wash my face, and have breakfast. Then I go to school or study English. In the afternoon, I usually do my homework and help my family with some housework. Sometimes I meet my friends or read a book. In the evening, I have dinner with my family and relax. I often watch a film or use the internet for learning. Before going to bed, I prepare for the next day. I usually go to sleep at about 10:30 p.m. In conclusion, I am happy with my daily routine because it helps me stay organized and productive.
№5.jovob_uz: Bu insho mening kundalik tartibim haqida. Mening kun tartibim oddiy. Ertalab soat 7 da uyg‘onaman, yuzimni yuvaman va nonushta qilaman. Keyin maktabga boraman yoki ingliz tilini o‘rganaman. Kunduzi uy vazifalarimni bajaraman va oilamga yordam beraman. Kechqurun oilam bilan ovqatlanaman, dam olaman va ba'zan film tomosha qilaman. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men o‘z kundalik tartibimdan mamnunman, chunki u menga tartibli va samarali bo‘lishga yordam beradi.
